dedupe_keys.name: rss kanal pro zmeny v opendata aplikace monitor statni pokladny

description: RSS kanál pro změny v OpenData aplikace MONITOR Státní pokladny is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstvo financí. Changes in the data catalog in MONITOR application. Budget and accounting information from all levels of central and local government. Coverage: Ministerstvo financí. The portal shows the English title as "RSS channel for OpenData in State treasury MONITOR application" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstvo financí. Its keywords include MONITOR, RSS, OpenData. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00006947/86d71dd7220d91a6428a2ca26ce3602b/distribuce/f7dff0436a697de6c66f648a57bb6d89/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
